1770-1933-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-1933-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
When Aether Adept enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

512-3814-4644.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-3814-4644.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-3814-4644.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1978-3430-5139-5793.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Relic of Sauron which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1987-2239-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2707-5751-6504-7692.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

2469-4699-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

4377-5531-7334.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-5531-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
4377-5531-7334.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using The Neutrinos.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

573-1479-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-7201.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-2919-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-2919-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2292-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2292-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6843-7061.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Solid Ground.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

147-2511-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

413-1778-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Memnite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3293-5411-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-5411-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-5411-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1350-1770-3390-3518-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

193-1238-6771.description:
If Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it, activate Heart of Kiran by removing a loyalty counter from Aminatou, causing Heart of Kiran to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Aminatou has one loyalty counter on it.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Shepherd of the Clouds.
Aminatou is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Aminatou ability, blinking Shepherd of the Clouds.
When Shepherd of the Clouds enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aminatou from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

763-2919-4929.description:
Activate Juju Bubble by paying {2}, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
763-2919-4929.notes: This will not put infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, but will on each other creature you control.

2060-2577-3967-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2577-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

uses.n: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

5796-6574.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
5796-6574.notablePrerequisites: There are eight or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
5796-6574.description:
Draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Kefka triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2468-2751-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 4.
1987-2468-2751-4249.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Nykthos and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1938-2511.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-5147.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-5147.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2792-3010-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Moonblade Shinobi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
2792-3010-3489.description:
Declare Moonblade Shinobi as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moonblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moonblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moonblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

57-2178-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4050-4242.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2092-2757-4449.notablePrerequisites:
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
2092-2757-4449.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Hateflayer, untapping the basic Mountain.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

3609-4279-4473.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
Six
3609-4279-4473.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding a card, causing you to put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Ezuri triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

155-1374-1962.description:
Cast Shields of Velis Vel either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}, giving creatures you control +0/+1 and all creature types until end of turn.
Repeat.
